title: Moral Foundations of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 30-item Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) to LLMs to measure their baseline tendencies across five moral dimensions (care/harm, fairness/cheating, loyalty/betrayal, authority/subversion, and sanctity/degradation), and assessing how artificially maximizing these moral dimensions affects downstream behaviors like charitable donations.

Comparing LLM responses on the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) to empirical data from human psychology studies, specifically matching the models' default and prompted moral profiles against human groups who self-identify as liberal, moderate, or conservative.
Evaluating the distance between LLMs' moral foundation scores and those of distinct human demographics, specifically comparing alignment with US-American versus South Korean populations.
